config.hypothesis: Confirm the original Phase 16 restricted imputation pipeline with inner-only threshold selection, reusing verified original outer predictions.

missing_values.fit_partition: corresponding training rows only; imputer receives no disease labels
missing_values.method: Original fold-fitted restricted imputation plus eight original indicators and quantile binning; remaining NaNs routed by trees.

threshold.selection_method: Exploratory pooled threshold retained for provenance; comparison uses inner-only thresholds in nested_threshold_evaluation.

outcome.diagnostic_metadata_correction: After training, corrected collapsed_flags to count occupied states instead of allocated bins. Preserved the executed helper and original preflight; all disease-model sources, training scores, probabilities, thresholds and metrics unchanged. Repeated the three outer checkpoint checks without disease-model training.

memory_estimate.basis: Largest retained float32 cleaned train/validation pair; excludes temporary histogram arrays and runtime overhead.

nested_threshold_evaluation.protocol: Each outer-fold threshold is selected from inner OOF probabilities fitted and preprocessed only on that outer fold's training rows.

outcome.runtime_basis: Six new inner fits including preprocessing; three historical outer fits reused, not included in this duration.
outcome.selection_note: Pooled OOF F1 uses the same labels to select and describe its threshold. Use nested_threshold_evaluation, when configured, for an unbiased threshold result.
